name: SPI Bus A
info:
Required by SPI Display
If display ties CS to GND then it must be the only device on SPI Bus A
If display is the only device on this bus, set SPIA_MISO = 255
Highly recommended to use default pins!

name: SPI Bus B
info:
The recommended bus for VS1053 when using an SPI display
Safe non-strapping pins will be blue color
